address: Block B, Wan Shou Hotel, 12A Wanshou Road, Haidian, Beijing, China Mainland
bio: Run by a team from Anhui, this restaurant opened its doors in 2023. The two-storey architecture seamlessly melds classical Anhui style and modern touches. The kitchen team imports most ingredients from Anhui for maximum authenticity. The signature dish, braised Huizhou smelly mandarin fish, is fermented in a wooden barrel for one month and boasts firm flesh and unique briny umami. In addition to the á la carte menu, check out the seasonal offerings....
